list.name: pollutant
list.label: Polluant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT pollutant FROM gold_pollution_hourly ORDER BY 1

list.name: city
list.label: Ville
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM gold_pollution_daily_city WHERE city IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Évolution horaire de la pollution par polluant

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hour_utc AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value,
  pollutant AS metric
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE hour_utc BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ('$pollutant' = 'All' OR pollutant IN ($pollutant))
  AND ('$city' = 'All' OR city IN ($city))
GROUP BY hour_utc, pollutant
ORDER BY hour_utc

panels.title: Niveau moyen de pollution par ville (dernières 24h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  city AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE hour_utc >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND city IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$pollutant' = 'All' OR pollutant IN ($pollutant))
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  pollutant AS metric,
  MAX(max_value) AS value
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE hour_utc >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND ('$pollutant' = 'All' OR pollutant IN ($pollutant))
  AND ('$city' = 'All' OR city IN ($city))
GROUP BY pollutant
ORDER BY pollutant

SELECT
  day_utc::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time,
  ROUND(avg_value::NUMERIC, 2) AS value,
  city || ' – ' || pollutant AS metric
FROM gold_pollution_daily_city
WHERE day_utc BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::DATE AND $__timeTo()::DATE
  AND ('$pollutant' = 'All' OR pollutant IN ($pollutant))
  AND ('$city' = 'All' OR city IN ($city))
ORDER BY day_utc

SELECT NOW() AS time, SUM(samples_count) AS value
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE hour_utc >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT sensor_id) AS value
FROM gold_pollution_hourly
WHERE hour_utc >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT
  city,
  ROUND(avg_value::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Moy PM2.5 (µg/m³)",
  ROUND(max_value::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Max PM2.5 (µg/m³)",
  samples_count                AS "Mesures"
FROM gold_pollution_daily_city
WHERE pollutant = 'pm25'
  AND day_utc = CURRENT_DATE - 1
  AND avg_value > 50
ORDER BY avg_value DESC
